## Overview

This document tests the **catalogue module** using a fully simulated dataset.
No external files are required. Each section is an independent node that can be
run in isolation to verify a specific function.

The simulated data represents a diploid species with:
- **20 bi-allelic SNP markers** across **3 chromosomes**
- **10 samples**, each with two phased haplotypes
- **5 haplotype blocks** (4 markers/block average)
- **One quantitative trait** with random marker effects

---

## 1  Generate Simulation Dataset

```{r sim-data}
library(haploStack)
library(data.table)

set.seed(42)

## ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_SAMPLES  <- 10L
N_MARKERS  <- 20L
N_CHROM    <- 3L
BLOCK_SIZE <- 4L
ENCODING   <- "nucleotide"       # "A/T" style (the one categorical vocabulary since 0.9.0)

## ── Genotype matrix (markers × samples) ───────────────────────────────────────
geno_mat <- sim_geno_matrix(N_SAMPLES, N_MARKERS, ENCODING)

cat("Genotype matrix dimensions:", dim(geno_mat), "\n")
cat("First 5 columns, first 3 rows:\n")
print(geno_mat[1:3, 1:5])
```

```{r sim-map}
## ── Marker map (Marker, Chrom, Pos) ───────────────────────────────────────────
map_df <- sim_map_data(rownames(geno_mat), n_chrom = N_CHROM)

cat("Map data (first 8 rows):\n")
print(head(map_df, 8))
cat("Chromosomes:", unique(map_df$Chrom), "\n")
cat("Position range:", range(map_df$Pos), "bp\n")
```

```{r sim-blockmap}
## ── Block map (Chrom, Marker, Block) ──────────────────────────────────────────
block_map_df <- sim_block_map(map_df, block_size = BLOCK_SIZE)

cat("Block map (first 8 rows):\n")
print(head(block_map_df, 8))
cat("Number of unique blocks:", length(unique(block_map_df$Block)), "\n")
```

```{r sim-effects}
## ── Marker effects (Marker, Allele, Effect) ───────────────────────────────────
## SelectionTools encoding uses alleles "1" and "4"
effect_df <- sim_effect_df(rownames(geno_mat), alleles = c("A","T"))

cat("Effect data (first 8 rows):\n")
print(head(effect_df, 8))
cat("Effect range:", round(range(effect_df$Effect), 3), "\n")
```

---

## 2  Assemble the GenoMeta object  [Node: `build_geno_meta` / `geno_meta_views`]

`GenoMeta` is the single central object — it bundles the genotype array, map,
block assignments, `sample_info`, and an optional `marker_effects` copy. The
denormalised profile views (wide allele table, marker/block metadata) are
derived on demand with `geno_meta_views()`; nothing is stored separately.

```{r create-profile}
## ── Node: build_geno_meta ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Input : geno_mat (markers × samples), map_df, block_map_df
## Output: GenoMeta object

meta <- build_geno_meta(geno_mat, map_df, blocks = block_map_df)

## Derived profile views (built on demand)
profile <- geno_meta_views(meta)

cat("View components:\n")
str(profile, max.level = 1)

cat("\nDetected encoding:", profile$encoding, "\n")
cat("Samples:", length(profile$samples), "\n")
cat("Markers:", nrow(profile$marker_meta), "\n")
cat("Blocks defined:", nrow(profile$block_meta), "\n")
cat("Alleles table rows:", nrow(profile$alleles),
    "(expected:", N_SAMPLES * 2L, "= n_samples × ploidy)\n")
```

### 2.1 Inspect allele table

```{r inspect-alleles}
## First 3 columns and 5 rows of the allele table
print(profile$alleles[1:5, 1:5, with = FALSE])
```

### 2.2 Block metadata

```{r block-meta}
cat("Block metadata:\n")
print(profile$block_meta)
cat("\nBlock sizes (markers):\n")
print(profile$block_meta[order(chromosome, start_pos)])
```

---

## 3  Filter the GenoMeta  [Node: `filter_geno_meta`]

```{r filter-profile}
## ── Node: filter_geno_meta ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## filter_geno_meta() returns a new GenoMeta; derive views with geno_meta_views()

## 3a — by samples
sub_samples <- geno_meta_views(filter_geno_meta(meta, keep_samples = c("S1","S2","S3")))
cat("After sample filter: samples =", length(sub_samples$samples), "\n")

## 3b — by blocks (first 2 blocks)
first_two_blocks <- profile$block_meta$block_id[1:2]
sub_blocks <- geno_meta_views(filter_geno_meta(meta, blocks = first_two_blocks))
cat("After block filter: n_markers =", nrow(sub_blocks$marker_meta), "\n")

## 3c — by chromosome
sub_chr1 <- geno_meta_views(filter_geno_meta(meta, chromosomes = list(list(chr = "1"))))
cat("After chr=1 filter: markers on chr1 =",
    nrow(sub_chr1$marker_meta), "\n")

## 3d — combined: samples + chromosome
sub_combo <- geno_meta_views(filter_geno_meta(meta,
                             keep_samples = c("S1","S4"),
                             chromosomes  = list(list(chr = "2"))))
cat("Combined filter: samples =", length(sub_combo$samples),
    ", markers =", nrow(sub_combo$marker_meta), "\n")
```

---

## 4  Save and Load GenoMeta  [Node: `save_geno_meta`]

```{r save-load-profile}
## ── Node: save/load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tmp_meta <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
save_geno_meta(meta, tmp_meta)
cat("GenoMeta saved to:", tmp_meta, "\n")

meta_reload <- load_geno_meta(tmp_meta)
cat("Reloaded samples:", nrow(meta_reload$sample_info), "\n")
cat("Valid GenoMeta:", is_geno_meta(meta_reload), "\n")
unlink(tmp_meta)
```

---

## 5  Recode GenoMeta  [Node: `recode_geno_meta`]

```{r recode-profile}
## ── Node: recode_geno_meta ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Since 0.9.0 a GenoMeta holds nucleotide alleles only, so this is a no-op on
## a fresh container; it is the explicit route for an object saved by an
## earlier version with SelectionTools codes (1/4), which load_geno_meta() and
## upgrade_geno_meta() also recode on their own.
meta_nuc <- recode_geno_meta(meta, to_type = "nucleotide")
cat("Original encoding:", meta$metadata$encoding, "\n")
cat("Recoded encoding:", meta_nuc$metadata$encoding, "\n")

## Show a sample value before/after recoding
cat("geno_arrays[1,1,1] — before:", meta$geno_arrays[1, 1, 1],
    "| after:", meta_nuc$geno_arrays[1, 1, 1], "\n")
```

---

## 6  Compute Local GEBV Matrix  [Node: `compute_profile_localgebv`]

```{r compute-gebv}
## ── Node: compute_profile_localgebv ───────────────────────────────────────────
## Input : GenoMeta, effect_df  (effect_df may be omitted if attached as
##         meta$marker_effects)
## Output: wide data.table (Block × Sample)

gebv_matrix <- compute_profile_localgebv(
  geno_meta      = meta,
  effect_df      = effect_df,
  level          = "genotype",
  center = "allele_freq"
)

cat("GEBV matrix dimensions:", dim(gebv_matrix), "\n")
cat("(Expected:", nrow(profile$block_meta), "blocks ×",
    length(profile$samples) + 1L, "cols inc. Block)\n\n")

print(gebv_matrix)
```

### 6.1  Haplotype-level output

```{r compute-gebv-hap}
gebv_hap <- compute_profile_localgebv(
  geno_meta      = meta,
  effect_df      = effect_df,
  level          = "haplotype",
  center = "none"
)
cat("Haplotype-level columns:", ncol(gebv_hap) - 1L,
    "(expected:", length(profile$samples) * 2L, ")\n")
```

### 6.2  Per-sample total GEBV summary

```{r gebv-summary}
sample_cols  <- setdiff(names(gebv_matrix), "Block")
total_gebv   <- colSums(gebv_matrix[, sample_cols, with = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
gebv_summary <- data.table(Sample = names(total_gebv), TotalGEBV = total_gebv)
gebv_summary <- gebv_summary[order(-TotalGEBV)]
cat("Per-sample GEBV summary:\n")
print(gebv_summary)
```

## 7  Block Location Info  [Node: `build_block_location_info`]

```{r block-location}
## ── Node: build_block_location_info ───────────────────────────────────────────
block_info <- build_block_location_info(meta)$block_info
cat("Block location table:\n")
print(as.data.table(block_info)[, .(Block, Chrom, Start, End,
                                    Block_length, Num_SNPs)])
```

## 8  Visualisation  [Node: `plot_haplotype_alignment`]

```{r plot-alignment, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
## ── Node: plot_haplotype_alignment ────────────────────────────────────────────
p_align <- plot_haplotype_alignment(
  meta,
  show_block_boundaries = TRUE,
  show_block_labels     = TRUE
)
print(p_align)
```

### 8.1  Manhattan plots

```{r plot-manhattan, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
## Effect
effect_plot_data <- data.table::melt(
  gebv_matrix,
  id.vars      = "Block",
  variable.name = "Sample",
  value.name   = "Effect"
)
effect_plot_data <- merge(effect_plot_data,
                           block_info[, .(Block, Chrom, Pos)],
                           by = "Block", all.x = TRUE)

p_eff <- plot_manhattan_effect(effect_plot_data, trait_name = "Simulated Trait")
print(p_eff)
```

```{r plot-variance, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
## Variance
block_var <- effect_plot_data[, .(BlockVariance = var(Effect, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               by = Block]
block_var <- merge(block_var, block_info[, .(Block, Chrom, Pos)], by = "Block")
p_var <- plot_manhattan_variance(block_var, trait_name = "Simulated Trait")
print(p_var)
```
